fusions.name: Helm Cleaver
fusions.desc: A full overhead chop that deals 30 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Splitting Wedge
fusions.desc: Chops through a wide arc 2.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything in it. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction the target carries (max 30%).

fusions.name: Headsman's Stance
fusions.desc: Increases your slashing damage by 25% for 12 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bearded Bit
fusions.desc: Conjures a heavy bearded axe head on your weapon. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your armour by 5%, and every strike with it makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
